","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"b","letter":"b","text":"প্রমাণ কর যে, \(\frac{1}{P} + \frac{1}{Q} = 1\)।","marks":0,"answer":"দেওয়া আছে: \(P = 2 - \sin^2\theta\), \(Q = 2 + \tan^2\theta\)
\(\frac{1}{P} + \frac{1}{Q} = \frac{1}{2 - \sin^2\theta} + \frac{1}{2 + \frac{\sin^2\theta}{\cos^2\theta}}\)
দ্বিতীয় পদ: \(\frac{1}{2 + \frac{\sin^2\theta}{\cos^2\theta}} = \frac{\cos^2\theta}{2\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta}\)

কিন্তু \(1 + \cos^2\theta = 2 - \sin^2\theta\)? যাচাই করা যাক:

","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"c","letter":"c","text":"সমাধান কর: \(\frac{4}{R^2} - (2 + 2\sqrt{3})\frac{1}{R} + \sqrt{3} = 0\), যেখানে \(\theta\) একটি সূক্ষ্মকোণ।","marks":0,"answer":"দেওয়া আছে: \(R = \csc\theta\)

কিন্তু \(R = \csc\theta = \frac{1}{\sin\theta}\), তাই \(R^2 = \csc^2\theta = \frac{1}{\sin^2\theta}\)
বেশি ভালো: ধরি \(t = \frac{1}{R} = \sin\theta\)
তাহলে \(4t^2 - (2 + 2\sqrt{3})t + \sqrt{3} = 0\)
\(\Rightarrow 4t^2 - 2t - 2\sqrt{3}t + \sqrt{3} = 0\)

নয় \(2t - \sqrt{3} = 0 \Rightarrow t = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \Rightarrow \sin\theta = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \Rightarrow \theta = 60^\circ\)
সুতরাং, \(\theta = 30^\circ\) অথবা \(60^\circ\) (উত্তর)
